summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market repurchases under its existing share buyback programme, with aggregated purchases between 13-17 July 2026 totaling approximately 3.97 million ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price ranging from ~644p to ~655p per share. The buyback is executed through UBS AG as broker pursuant to instructions issued on 16 February 2026. All repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing issued share capital. The filing provides updated treasury and voting-rights figures. This is a routine issuer capital return via an announced buyback programme; no special-situation M&A or restructuring is involved. Watch for continued execution pace and any programme adjustments.
